strings.subtitle: — File nas karnwalo —
strings.dnd_hint: (ya file ko is window mein kheench)
strings.dnd_unavailable: Kheench aur chhod uplabdh nahi. Neeche wala button istemal kar.
strings.shred_button: N A S   K A R
strings.ssd_warning:
Chetavni! SSD par TRIM ki wajah se overwrite vidhi nas ki guarantee nahi deti.
Ye program HDD ke liye hai.
strings.confirm_text:
File "{name}" overwrite aur delete hogo.

Aage badh?
strings.confirm_lnk_text:
This is a shortcut (.lnk). Only the shortcut itself will be destroyed.

The target file it points to will remain intact.

Continue?
strings.drive_remote_warning:
This is a network drive (\\server\share).
Sector overwrite does not guarantee destruction — the server may have snapshots, deduplication or CoW.

Continue?
strings.drive_removable_warning:
This is a removable drive (USB stick / external HDD).
The controller may keep old blocks in reserve.

Continue?
strings.report_limits:
• NTFS vikalp data stream (ADS) process nahi hote.
• USN journal saaf nahi hota.
• Shadow copy aur cloud sync
  (OneDrive wagairah) par asar nahi padta.
strings.status_full: Saamagri poori tarah shunya se overwrite kar di gayi. Wapsi asambhav — auzaar sirf shunya dekhenge.
strings.status_fast: Sir, poonch aur 4 MB patti overwrite kar di gayi. Baaki achhooti hai, par khaali jagah ki wajah se consumer auzaar se poori wapsi asambhav hai. Gupt dastavejon ke liye POORA mode istemal kar.
strings.status_empty: File khaali thi, overwrite ki zaroorat nahi thi. Delete kar di.
strings.error_permission: File tak pahunch nahi hai. Kisi doosre program mein khuli ho sakti hai. Band kar aur phir koshish kar.
strings.error_not_found: File nahi mili. Ho sakta hai pehle hi delete ho gayi ho.
strings.error_is_symlink: Ye symbolic link hai. Link nas nahi kar sakte — target file surakshit rahegi.
strings.error_reparse: Ye placeholder file hai (OneDrive ya samaan). Iska data cloud mein hai, disk par nahi — yahan nas karne ko kuch nahi.
strings.error_not_file: Ye file nahi (folder ya kuch aur). File chhod.
strings.error_hardlinks: Is file mein doosre hard link hain (kul {n}). Hard link ka koi primary nahi hota — sab naam barabar hain. Agar vartaman raaste se nas karo, data overwrite aur 32 byte tak kat jayega, par bacha hissa doosre link se pahunch sakta hai. Pehle sab link delete kar.
strings.error_compressed:
File sikuDi, encrypt ya virala hai. Shunya se overwrite purane data ke nas ki guarantee nahi deta kyonki NTFS unhe alag tareeke se rakhta hai.

Visheshta hata: daahina click → Gun → Unnat → "Sikod" aur/ya "Encrypt" se tick hata. Phir SHREDDER phir chala.
